name: SeekOut
notes: Pricing page lists per-seat pricing, a 14-day free trial and enterprise pricing by quote; no list prices are shown. ATS integration is a listed feature on some tiers. The homepage fetch returned embedded instructions, which were ignored. Language options, parent company and API status were not stated on the pages read. Recruiting SaaS. The MCP connector page says sign-in is used, with no API keys for standard use. The MCP docs link (docs.seekout.com) returned an HTTP 403 challenge page in the browser reader and was not retried. Houses an ATS integration partner page.

review.note: Homepage, pricing, partners, about and MCP pages read; docs.seekout.com returned an HTTP 403 challenge page in the browser reader and was not retried.
